content_sections.heading: ESIC Hospital Bhilai Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Hospital Bhilai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Hospital Bhilai Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for ESIC Hospital Bhilai Specialist and Senior Resident posts is scheduled for 23 September 2026. Candidates should report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Specialist and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 23 vacancies announced by ESIC Hospital Bhilai. This includes 15 posts for Specialist (Full Time / Part Time) and 8 posts for Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a PG Degree/Diploma in the concerned specialty and registration with the Medical Council of India (MCI).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Specialist and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: For Specialist posts, the age limit is not exceeding 69 years. For Senior Resident posts, the age limit is not exceeding 45 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Specialist and Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The salary for Full-time Specialist and Senior Resident (with PG Degree) is Rs. 1,37,837/- per month plus TA and DA. Part-time Specialists receive Rs. 60,000/- per month for 16 hours/week.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ESIC Hospital Bhilai Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 500/- for Unreserved, OBC, and EWS categories. Female candidates, SC/ST, and PwD candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts is based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ESIC Hospital, Bhilai, on the fourth floor. Candidates should report between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to submit an online application before the walk-in?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to apply online beforehand; they should report directly to the venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).
